name: add_to_cart
description: Add units of a real product to the signed-in shopper's bag and return the updated bag. Quantity is added to any existing quantity. Prices come from the database. Does not reserve stock, create an order or charge money. Repeating a successful call adds again; after an uncertain result, read get_cart before deciding what to do.

productId.description: The exact product UUID returned by search_products or get_product.

quantity.description: Units to add, from 1 to 99. The resulting quantity must not exceed 99 or current stock.

name: get_cart
description: Read the signed-in shopper's current bag, quantities, current prices and availability. Does not change the bag or reserve stock.

name: get_my_orders
description: List summaries of the signed-in shopper's most recent 100 orders, newest first. Includes real order IDs, order status, payment status and totals. An empty list means this account has no orders. Does not create orders or advance payment/shipping.

name: get_order_status
description: Read one order belonging to the signed-in shopper, including its separate order/payment states, items, timeline and cancellation/refund eligibility. Use the order UUID from get_my_orders, not the display number. Eligibility is information, not approval. Does not change the order, advance shipping or charge/refund money.

orderId.description: The exact order UUID from get_my_orders. Not the CP- display number.

name: get_pending_action_status
description: Read a review belonging to the signed-in shopper using its exact action UUID. Returns the immutable terms, expiry, current review status and resulting order ID if completed. Also reads expired, superseded, rejected or completed reviews. Never approves, rejects, creates an order or advances a payment. Pending means human approval is still required in the storefront; Completed means the review executed, not necessarily that payment succeeded.

actionId.description: The exact review UUID returned by prepare_order or the storefront review API. Not an order UUID.

name: get_product
description: Read a public product by its real ID from search_products. Returns current price and stock. Does not reserve stock.

productId.description: The exact product UUID returned by search_products.

name: prepare_cancellation
description: Prepare a five-minute cancellation review for one of the shopper's orders before dispatch. Does not cancel, refund, void payment or release stock. Supersedes an earlier pending cancellation review for the same order; never retry automatically. Present the exact returned terms for an explicit human button approval. Order eligibility is rechecked when approved.

orderId.description: The exact owned order UUID from get_my_orders, not the CP- display number.

name: prepare_order
description: Prepare a five-minute checkout review from the signed-in shopper's current bag and server prices. Does NOT place an order, reserve stock, charge money or approve anything. Replaces any previous pending checkout review for this shopper; do not retry automatically. Present the returned terms in the application's trusted review UI for explicit human button approval; a chat message alone is not approval. Returns the review ID, expiry, snapshot and status; use get_pending_action_status to read it.

paymentMode.description: Local demo payment outcome after human approval: success, failure or delay. No real payment occurs.

name: prepare_refund
description: Prepare a five-minute full-refund review for the shopper's delivered order with captured payment, within 30 days of delivery. Does not refund or restock. Partial refunds and returns are unsupported. Supersedes an earlier pending refund review for this order; never retry automatically. Present returned terms for explicit human button approval; eligibility is checked again on approval.

orderId.description: The exact owned order UUID from get_my_orders, not the CP- display number.

name: remove_from_cart
description: Remove a product's entire line from the signed-in shopper's bag and return the remaining bag. If already absent, return the unchanged bag. Does not cancel orders, change inventory or refund payments.

productId.description: The exact product UUID from the shopper's get_cart result.

name: search_products
description: Search the public CommercePilot catalog. Returns real product IDs, prices in USD, current stock and pagination. Does not change a bag, reserve stock or place an order.

search.description: Literal text to find in product names or descriptions. Maximum 100 characters.

category.description: One of Audio, Workspace, Everyday or Gaming. Omit for all categories.

minPrice.description: Minimum unit price in USD, at least zero.

maxPrice.description: Maximum unit price in USD, at least the minimum price.

inStock.description: Return only products with stock above zero.

name: update_cart_item
description: Set an existing item in the signed-in shopper's bag to an exact total quantity. This replaces the quantity; it does not add units. Use remove_from_cart to remove an item. Prices and availability are checked again. Does not reserve stock, create an order or charge money.

productId.description: The exact product UUID from the shopper's get_cart result.

quantity.description: The desired total quantity, from 1 to 99 and no more than current stock. Zero is invalid; use remove_from_cart instead.
